verdicts.question: Is the cable routing in the site photos continuous and consistent across the documented run — from rooftop panels to DCDB to inverter to ACDB to solar meter to main panel — with no orphan ends, no unexplained mid-run size changes, and visible conduit / cable-tie / clipping where the run is exposed?
verdicts.designer_notes: No designer answer for this target — the vision routine verifies it by tracing cables across photos with 'Cable Routing', 'Equipment Location', 'Meter Box' and similar captions on pages 4+.
verdicts.photo_observation: Cable routing is traceable and color-consistent from the rooftop LA marker (p.12, orange LA cable) down through a 40mm PVC conduit at each floor transition (pp.13-14, red/green DC & AC earthing cables), into the 1st floor inverter/DCDB/ACDB room (p.15, wall diagram matching the same cable colors), continuing down to the ground floor (p.15-16) and terminating at labeled DC Earth Pit, AC Earth Pit, and LA Pit markers (p.16) that match the Cable Routing Legend (p.4) color coding. However, the chain does not yet extend to an installed solar meter or main panel, since the LT panel/meter is explicitly 'not yet installed' (p.16), and no PV module array is physically installed yet to show module-to-DCDB wiring.
verdicts.rationale: The LA/earthing cable segment of the run (roof to earth pits) is well-documented, continuous, and color-consistent with no orphan ends. But the full requested chain (panels → DCDB → inverter → ACDB → solar meter → main panel) cannot be fully verified end-to-end because the PV array, solar meter, and main LT panel are not yet physically installed at this pre-construction-completion stage of the site.
